Hi Heidi — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Summary of procurement options we discussed:
- Marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure): fastest from a buying perspective but requires a marketplace PO or card payment depending on your procurement rules.
- Direct Redwood invoice + PO (Net30): standard for enterprise customers; requires vendor onboarding packet (W-9, banking details) and our sales ops team to create a vendor profile.
- Card / P-Card: possible for initial pilot, may be easier for procurement but has limits on contract length/commitment.

Heidi indicated Acme prefers a PO with Net30 for new vendor relationships and will check whether marketplace procurement is an option for pilot.

Action items
- Heidi / Procurement: confirm whether you will (a) proceed with a PO and provide a PO number and vendor setup contact, or (b) prefer card for pilot and provide cardholder contact.
- Logan / Sales Ops (cc Marissa): if PO path chosen, Marissa will send our vendor packet and follow up on W-9 and banking instructions.
- Heidi: if you can share procurement@acmeanalytics.com contact or a short vendor-intake checklist, that will speed things up.

Attachments: I’ve attached a brief vendor packet template (redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf) that lists the usual fields procurement requests. If it’s useful I can pre-fill the banking instructions to reduce back-and-forth.

Proposed timeline: receive confirmation of PO vs card within 48 hours; vendor packet completed within 3 business days after that.

Thanks again — happy to jump back on a quick handoff call with your procurement contact if helpful.

Best,
